findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text.
findings.body: The Lithuanian account message is now `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence in the TOTP setup. Use a Lithuanian translation, for example `Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:`.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text.
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login bundle is now the Italian sentence `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`. Lithuanian users will see Italian on the OTP setup page. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: The account UI bundle now uses MessageFormat placeholders instead of i18next `{{n}}` interpolation.
findings.body: The JS apps format messages with i18next, which expects the `{{0}}` placeholders this line used before. With `{0}` and `{2,choice,...}`, the account console may show the raw placeholders and the choice pattern instead of the values whenever this validation error appears. I could not see how the account UI formats this key; that is the one fact that could prevent the problem. Unless that code uses Java-style MessageFormat, keep `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` and use i18next plurals rather than a ChoiceFormat.

findings.title: The admin UI bundle now uses MessageFormat placeholders instead of i18next `{{n}}` interpolation.
findings.body: This file uses i18next `{{name}}` interpolation elsewhere (for example `{{error}}` and `{{fieldName}}`). Changing this key to `{0}` and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` means i18next will likely show the placeholders and the choice syntax literally instead of the attribute name and limits. Keep `{{0}}`-style placeholders here, and use i18next pluralization if plural forms are needed.

findings.title: Guessing the English file name crashes the verifier when no matching `_en` file exists.
findings.body: The English file path is built by replacing `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` with `_en.properties`. A bundle whose base name contains an underscore and has no locale, such as the old fixture `duplicate_keys.properties` (which had to be renamed), maps to a file that does not exist (`duplicate_en.properties`). The same happens for any theme with no English counterpart at the derived path. In those cases the code throws an unchecked `RuntimeException` that aborts the whole Maven run, and it is not reported as a `MojoExecutionException` or as a message. Handle a missing English bundle gracefully, for example by treating the English text as empty or adding a message, and throw `MojoExecutionException` for read errors.

findings.title: The anchor mismatch message leaves out the key and the file.
findings.body: `Didn't find anchor tag ... in original string` does not say which key or file failed, even though the `Illegal HTML` message does. When this fails across dozens of bundles, nobody can tell where the problem is. Add the key and file name, as the other message does.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text in the Simplified Chinese bundle.
findings.body: The new `totpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional characters (手機, 應用程式), but this is the zh_CN bundle. Use Simplified Chinese, for example `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.
